adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code wraps the token refresh call with `refreshOAuthTokens()`. The `refreshOAuthTokens` function (in packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts) returns either a fetch Response object (when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true) or the result of refreshFunction(). When credential sync is enabled, it returns `response` which is a fetch Response, not the parsed token data. The original code expected `hubspotClient.oauth.tokensApi.createToken()` to return a HubspotToken directly. Now when credential sync is enabled, `hubspotRefreshToken` will be a Response object, and accessing `.accessToken`, `.refreshToken`, `.expiresIn` will be undefined, causing incorrect data to be persisted.
